name: Sesame Shrimp Stir-Fry with Egg, Asparagus, Bok Choy, Edamame & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
3 small bunches asparagus
9 baby bok choy
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Trim green onions and cut crosswise into ¼-inch pieces; place in a large bowl.
Snap or cut off woody ends of the asparagus; cut into 1-inch pieces and add to the bowl with the green onion.
Trim bok choy and cut crosswise into 1-inch strips; add to the bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger; set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, place eggs, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 eggs
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Pour eggs into the pot; scramble using a combination of stirring and folding. Cook until eggs are no longer runny, about 3 minutes. Remove eggs to a plate and set aside.
Return the pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add ginger and cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add shrimp, veggies, and edamame to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are tender and shrimp are cooked through, 7-8 minutes.
Return eggs to the pot. Add soy sauce and sesame seeds; stir to combine and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup soy sauce
3 tbsp sesame seeds

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and shrimp stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
